Passwords are a great way to make sure nobody but you can make in-app purchases on Google Play. Here are some quick steps to do this: - Go to Google Play >> Press the Menu Key >> Settings >> User Controls - Select Use PIN for Purchases or Password (you will be asked to enter your password) Naturally, its a good idea to keep your password a secret, even from your kids.\nPlease review your devices user manual or contact your device manufacturer for additional information. Note that it is Gamelofts policy to put a cap on in-app purchases to prevent accidental or duplicate purchases.

A great way to prevent accidental in-app purchases is to require your Amazon password before making any. Just follow these quick steps: - Go to the Amazon Appstore >> Press the Menu Key >> Settings >> Parental Controls - Set Enable Parental Controls to On (youll be asked to enter your existing Amazon password)\nNaturally, its a good idea to keep your password a secret, even from your kids. Note that it is Gamelofts policy to put a cap on in-app purchases to prevent accidental or duplicate purchases.
